meta.readMe: The pool is the top DPS rankings for one spec, which biases it toward fast kills: a mechanic that only appears late may be under-represented or absent, and 'journalOnly' lists catalogued abilities the pool never cast. Times are given both from the pull start (atSeconds) and from the start of the phase segment they landed in (atSegmentSeconds); the second is the stable one. A segment index is not a phase number -- phases repeat, so read phaseId/cycle.

journal.title: Gravebound Advance
journal.description: Restless Amani are protected by a necrotic barrier, absorbing magic damage equal to 25% of their maximum health. While the barrier holds, the Restless Amani cannot be destroyed and fixate on the Soulcoil Well.

journal.title: Hungering Pyre
journal.description: The Echo of Jawae erupts in soul fire, inflicting 5000440 Fire damage split evenly between players within 10 yards. Slithering Flames seek out players who are not hit by the pyre.

journal.title: Invoke
journal.description: Nek'zali invokes the Soulcoil Rite and calls upon the Latent Cultists to perform an Entwined Step.

journal.title: Possession Barrage
journal.description: Nek'zali launches spectral echoes in the direction of her primary target that burst on impact, inflicting 291692 Shadow damage to all players. This damage is reduced the farther each echo travels.

journal.title: Ritual Burn
journal.description: Increases damage taken from Soulcoil Rite by 15% for 1 min. This effect stacks.

journal.title: Soul Transfer
journal.description: Jawae transfers her essence to an Echo of Jawae over 15 sec. A surge of soul energy then inflicts 666725 Shadow damage to players caught in the blast.

journal.title: Soulcoil Ignition
journal.description: Nek'zali stirs the Soulcoil Well, invoking the Soulcoil Rite every 1 sec for 4 sec. During the channel, Anguished Echoes emerge from the well.

journal.title: Soulcoiler's Curse
journal.description: The Drowned Echo coils around all players within the well, ejecting them and leaving them Soulcoiled.

journal.title: Swirling Spirit
journal.description: Spirits swirl within the Soulcoil Well, inflicting 66673 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 5 sec on contact. This effect stacks.

journal.title: Uncoiled Rage
journal.description: Upon reaching full energy, Nek'zali gains her full potential, increasing her attack and movement speeds by 150% and all damage by 500%. Additionally, grants immunity to Taunt effects.
